newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain one-year bill yields seen steady at auction.
newsitem.headline: Spain one-year bill yields seen steady at auction.

text.p: Spanish one-year Treasury bill yields should remain unchanged at an auction on Wednesday from the previous sale at 6.508 percent, dealers predicted.
On the grey market, the bills were trading on Tuesday morning near 6.48/52 percent.
"It is very likely we will see the same yields we had two weeks ago," a dealer said.
The previous auction on one-year bills was held on October 29, when the yields declined little from a record low set on October 16 of 6.503 percent.
